entry.summaryHtml: Dark chocolate, heavily roasted coffee, mocha, molasses, pecan, black pepper, earth and leather make the V642 Piston a dark, concentrated Broadleaf cigar with plenty of roasted sweetness. The box-pressed 42 ring should keep the wrapper prominent while producing dense smoke and a long coffee-cocoa finish, with pepper and earth adding weight rather than overwhelming the sweeter notes.
productionLines: Filler: Dominican Piloto Cubano Ligero + Nicaraguan Ligero
practicalLines: Pre-cut before lighting into two 3¼″ × 42 sessions
